name: Workflow lint
protects: A workflow GitHub would read differently from how it was written: a mistyped input name, which GitHub reads as an empty string rather than refusing, a bad expression or a wrong key, in a workflow that runs only on dispatch or on the schedule and so fails nowhere before it matters. And a shell script under scripts/, several of which the CI job runs, that does something other than its author meant, such as a variable left unquoted and split into words, which can make a check pass that should fail.
howToTellArmed: The "Lint the workflows" step appears in every run of the CI workflow.
